newsitem.title: USA: Southern postpones Farley, Ala. nuke startup.
newsitem.headline: Southern postpones Farley, Ala. nuke startup.

text.p: Southern Co has delayed the expected restart of its 822 megawatt Farley 2 nuclear power unit until mid-December from original plans for a restart at the end of November, a company spokeswoman said Tuesday.
"December 15 is our new target date (for a restart)," said spokeswoman Loretto Stevens, adding "there are some more maintenance items they want to take care of."
The Dothan, Ala., unit was shut Oct 12 for scheduled refueling and maintenance and had originally been scheduled to be out for about 45 days with a restart near Nov 30.
The 812 megawatt Farley 1 nuclear unit at the same site was operating at 100 percent of capacity as of early Tuesday, according to the Nuclear Regulatory Commission's daily plant status report.
